title: DTS Lib
description: Shared in-game settings hub for my mods, reachable from the pause menu.
body:
# DTS Lib

A small client-side library mod that adds a single **Dotshow Mods** button to the in-game pause (Escape) menu. Each compatible Dotshow mod registers its own settings page inside this shared hub, so you get one tidy entry instead of a separate menu item per mod. No ModMenu required.

## For players

Install it alongside any Dotshow mod that depends on it (such as **Better Totem Counter**). Open the pause menu, click **Dotshow Mods**, and you'll find every installed mod's settings in one place.

## Requirements

- Fabric Loader 0.16.9+
- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
